description: Evaluating \(s(s(x_0))\) gives the interpretation of the unary function applied twice to the assigned value of \(x_0\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderStructures.doubleUnary_realize.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type u_1}
  [L.Structure M] (s : L.Functions 1) (a : ℕ → M) :
  FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize a (s.apply₁ (s.apply₁ (FirstOrder.Language.var 0))) =
    FirstOrder.Language.Structure.funMap s ![FirstOrder.Language.Structure.funMap s ![a 0]]
